name: Box Slopes: Player rises · 3t at (0, 5, 1)
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 3 ticks after Start.
Box 0: 2 cells, starting at (0, 3, 1) through (0, 4, 1); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Blue box slope.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north and 1 up.
Tick 2: Player moves 1 north.
Tick 3: Player moves 1 north and 1 down.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
